exposure: Type of suture material for skin closure (absorbable vs non-absorbable)
cohort: Women undergoing cesarean birth at an Adelaide maternity hospital
finding: The combination of subcutaneous fascia closure and skin closure with an absorbable suture may be associated with an increased risk of reported wound infection after cesarean section.
mod_finding: The combination of subcutaneous fascia closure and skin closure with absorbable sutures after a Cesarean section may lead to an increased risk of wound infection.
